title: Two tickets. Five minutes.
scenario: Someone in your school group chat offers two sold-out concert tickets at face value because their parents changed plans. They need payment in five minutes because “another buyer is waiting.”

answers.A: Send half now to hold the tickets, then the rest after they transfer them.
answers.B: Use a ticket platform with verified transfer and buyer protection, or skip the deal.
answers.C: Ask for a live screen recording showing the tickets inside the official ticket app before paying.

explanation: Pressure makes a risky payment feel like the only way to keep the deal. Protection matters more than speed.
proTip: A good deal should survive a safe payment method.
